results.name: ccda-entries-x10/stage/document-table
results.extra: Running the adapter's document-table query on every record of the document, to link a record to any other record, in the document or not. (Specification stage: link records.)

results.name: ccda-entries-x10/stage/lift
results.extra: Reading the source document into the triples the adapter's queries can ask about, one record at a time. (Specification stage: read and chunk.)

results.name: ccda-entries-x10/stage/source-validation
results.extra: Checking each source record, and the document as a whole where the adapter gives a document schema, against the adapter's schema (XSD or JSON Schema). A failure is a finding, never a refusal. (Specification stage: check, validate.)

results.name: ccda-entries-x10/stage/accounting
results.extra: Working out, against the adapter's accounting file, what became of each part of each source record.

results.name: ccda-entries-x10/stage/dataset
results.extra: Putting the facts about a record into the store its queries run over.

results.name: ccda-entries-x10/stage/index
results.extra: Building the lookup structure that compiled queries read, from a record's triples. A query the general evaluator answers needs none.

results.name: ccda-entries-x10/stage/mapping
results.extra: Running the adapter's mapping queries on each record, without the time of building their lookup structure. (Specification stage: transform.)

results.name: ccda-entries-x10/stage/records
results.extra: Turning what the mapping produced into each record's graph: naming its versions, keeping one where the mapping wrote several, and writing their arrivals. (Specification stage: name versions, write arrivals.)

results.name: ccda-entries-x10/stage/output-validation
results.extra: Checking each record's output against the vocabulary's SHACL shapes.

results.name: ccda-entries-x10/stage/findings
results.extra: Running the adapter's findings queries to find what the source record got wrong or left out. (Specification stage: findings.)

results.name: ccda-entries-x10/stage/unresolved-addresses
results.extra: Finding the references to records the document does not hold, which keep their computed names.

results.name: ccda-entries-x10/stage/detect
results.extra: Running the adapter's detect query, which reports whether the adapter reads this document. The Bridge converts every record whatever the answer; it never routes.

results.name: ccda-entries-x10/stage/summary
results.extra: Counting the graph's distinct triples and the findings once every record is done.

results.name: ccda-entries-x10/stage/serialising
results.extra: Writing the graph and the findings out as Turtle or N-Triples.

results.name: ccda-entries-x10/stage/unaccounted
results.extra: Seconds of the profiled convert that none of the stages accounts for, such as writing the document and the import into the graph.

results.name: ccda-entries-x10/output/graph
results.extra: Distinct triples in the output graph, with a SHA-256 fingerprint of the output that is the same whenever the content is the same, whatever order the engine wrote it in and whatever it named its blank nodes.

results.name: ccda-entries-x10/output/findings
results.extra: Distinct triples in the findings, with a SHA-256 fingerprint of them that is the same whenever the content is the same, whatever order the engine wrote them in and whatever it named its blank nodes.

results.name: ccda/load
results.extra: Seconds to read the adapter's and the vocabulary's files, describe the adapter and prepare it, with the engine already started.

results.name: ccda/load/read-files
results.extra: Seconds of the load spent reading files from disk.

results.name: ccda/load/prepare
results.extra: Seconds of the load spent describing the adapter and preparing it: parsing and compiling its queries, schemas and shapes.

results.name: ccda/load/files-read
results.extra: Files read for the load, the adapter's and the vocabulary's.

results.name: ccda/load/missing-files
results.extra: Files the load needed that the adapter's description did not list, which the host read from the folder as the load asked for them.

results.name: ccda/boot/read-wasm
results.extra: Seconds to read the engine's compiled code from disk.

results.name: ccda/boot/compile-wasm
results.extra: Seconds to turn the engine's compiled code into something the machine can run.

results.name: ccda/boot/instantiate-wasm
results.extra: Seconds to start the compiled code, which runs its start-up work.
